name: 5624-coldprefill-dsv2lite-1gpu
model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite-Instruct, bf16, unquantized -- ~31 GB of weights, 15.7B total / 2.4B active.
parallelism: tp1 -- one GPU, no tensor, pipeline, data or expert parallelism, no router, no external cache tier.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=16, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 1024 requests with a 2400 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text` over /v1/completions, single turn, no prefix reuse: every request is 4096 prompt tokens (stdev 0) generating exactly 128 tokens (stdev 0, `ignore_eos`), seed 42.
purpose: A code-completion helper turning 4,000-token file contexts into short snippets for 16 concurrent developers on one GPU.
launch:
# The engine's command line. Every value here is a declaration of the setup, not a tunable.

model-path: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite-Instruct
trust-remote-code: true

tp-size: 1
attention-backend: fa3
disable-radix-cache: true
chunked-prefill-size: -1
max-prefill-tokens: 16384
page-size: 1

# MANDATORY, not tidy: the checkpoint advertises 163840 positions via YaRN, and the engine sizes
# ReqToTokenPool as (max_num_reqs+1) x (context_len+4) int32 with max_num_reqs clamped to at least
# 2048 -- at 163840 that is ~1.3 TB and the server never starts. 8192 covers a request of this
# workload (4096 prompt + 128 generated) with wide margin and costs ~67 MB.
context-length: 8192

mem-fraction-static: 0.85
random-seed: 42
